content: Loki single-binary filesystem (tsdb shipper, schema v13, object_store filesystem, inmemory ring, replication_factor 1) with compactor retention_enabled + retention_period 168h fits a tight VPS. Footprint: Loki ~256-512MB, Promtail ~50MB, Grafana ~256MB, Uptime Kuma ~128MB. RAM-optimal alternative: pino-loki transport pushes app logs directly to Loki HTTP API (no scraper container) and the same transport targets Grafana Cloud Loki for the D-04 fallback by swapping host+basicAuth.
